Initial release of persona-researcher.

- Organize research papers, notes, and references in Drive.
- Write and summarize research notes using Docs integration.
- Track and log research data in Sheets.
- Share files and findings with collaborators.
- Request peer reviews through Gmail.
- Includes tips for searching, logging, and exporting research data.
